candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to acc.unlockTime so it always sets unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime (no lower-bound to block.timestamp).
Replace acc.balance increment with setting acc.balance equal to the sent value (overwriting previous balance).
Replace require that checked overflow with a stricter require preventing zero-value deposits by requiring msg.value > 0.
Insert a statement that doubles the reported msg.value passed to the logger by adding the same amount to msg.value before logging (state unchanged), causing Log to record a different value.
Replace setting acc.unlockTime with setting it to block.timestamp (ignoring provided _unlockTime), which changes when funds become collectible.
Change the condition to allow Collect when acc.balance >= _am even if it's below MinSum, so MinSum check is removed.
Change comparison on unlockTime from strict greater to greater-or-equal so collect can occur when block.timestamp == acc.unlockTime.
Reverse the order of checks: check unlockTime first, potentially short-circuit behavior earlier (could affect reentrancy timing effects).
Move the acc.balance decrement to after the external call, so balance is reduced only if the transfer succeeded (changes observed balances on failure/success).
Change external call to use transfer-style revert by using require on the call success and remove explicit revert to alter gas forwarding semantics.
